coordination.workSelection: Any contributor or chat may select any unaccepted task from the sole tracker. Domain groups show thematic coverage only; no exclusive lanes, claims, or worker assignments exist.
coordination.concurrentWrites: Before editing, fetch current main and compare affected paths. Avoid known simultaneous same-file edits; coordinate directly when necessary. Use fresh blob SHA for contents writes or an exact expected-head lease for atomic commits. Never force overwrite, silently replace a peer change, or write from a stale snapshot.
coordination.migrations: Any contributor may prepare and register numbered migrations, schema barrels, journals and snapshots, but integrate changes serially against freshly fetched main, recheck the next migration number, and prove full registered replay, drift and relevant PostgreSQL negatives before acceptance. Two writers must never simultaneously reserve the same migration number.
coordination.taskAcceptance: One OPEN original-scope task at a time. Preserve task dependencies, executed exact-SHA acceptance evidence, frozen accepted tasks and independent phase certification. No owner claims or handoff approval is required to work across domains.
coordination.integrationNotes: The integrationNotes collection preserves historical technical dependencies and blockers, not outstanding permission requests or exclusive ownership.
coordination.verification: Independent security and database verification remains mandatory where specified; it is an evidence gate, not a team assignment.
coordination.commitProtocol: Write focused cohesive commits to main only after reviewing the latest head and file SHAs. On conflict refetch and reconcile the intended change without force; never discard concurrent work.
testTiers: During change: focused source, unit, type or SQL guards
Task acceptance: exact-SHA disposable registered PostgreSQL replay/drift plus applicable tenant/private/FK/state/race negatives and real producer/consumer
Global phase: complete applicable build/lint/typecheck/browser/security and release-only provider/recovery gates
coordination.progressRule: Only verified task.done and milestone.done provide accepted counts. Domain groups, historical notes and source progress estimates do not certify a task or phase.

startupProcedure: Read AGENTS.md and docs/tracker.json on current main; run npm run progress -- --closure-next before choosing a task.
Select any OPEN task that has a finite, testable remaining gate; no lane claim or domain restriction is required.
Check latest main SHA, affected files, registration state and any concurrent edits before making a narrowly scoped change.

For staging/disposition-only scopes, run exact-source tests and name the separately OPEN runtime integration tasks. For registered/runtime work, require disposable PostgreSQL replay, drift, tenant/privacy/race negatives and producer-consumer proof.
Integrate numbered migrations and shared schema edits serially with a fresh-head check; coordinate competing same-path edits but do not create an ownership lane.
Accept a task only after its original full scoped acceptance passes, recording acceptedAt and executed acceptanceEvidence. Never promote source-only checks to deployed DB acceptance.
After two useful passes without an accepted task, document the exact blocker and switch to an independent OPEN task.
Report current accepted count, accepted task IDs, code SHA and run URLs, plus unresolved blockers. No background work or fabricated status.
